blocks.text: Welcome to Dealinee Estate (“we,” “our,” “us,” or “the Company”).

2.1 Property Rental Services

items: Assisting property owners and landlords in finding prospective tenants.
Helping tenants identify suitable residential or commercial properties.
Coordinating property visits and discussions between owners and prospective tenants.
Assisting with rental negotiations and documentation coordination.

blocks.text: 2.2 Property Buying Services

items: Assisting prospective buyers in identifying suitable properties.
Providing available property information and arranging site visits.
Connecting buyers with property owners, developers, builders, or authorised representatives.
Facilitating communication and negotiations between interested parties.

blocks.text: 2.3 Property Selling Services

items: Assisting property owners in marketing and promoting their properties.
Connecting sellers with potential buyers.
Coordinating property inspections, enquiries, and negotiations.
Supporting the transaction process as an intermediary or channel partner.

blocks.text: 2.4 Property Management Services

items: Assisting property owners with rental and property-related coordination.
Coordinating tenant enquiries, rent-related communication, maintenance requests, and other agreed services.
Providing property management support according to the separate agreement entered into with the property owner.

blocks.text: The exact scope, fees, responsibilities, and duration of any service may be specified in a separate written agreement.

blocks.text: Dealinee Estate is not responsible for changes or inaccuracies in information supplied by third parties, except to the extent required by applicable law.
Customers are advised to independently verify the legal, financial, technical, and physical details of any property before entering into a transaction.
This may include:

items: Ownership and title documents.
Sale deeds and chain of title.
Encumbrance and applicable land records.
Building approvals and sanctioned plans.
Applicable RERA registration and project details.
Property tax and utility dues.
Land-use permissions and other statutory approvals.
Physical condition, measurements, boundaries, and access.

blocks.text: Dealinee Estate may assist in coordinating document collection or communication where agreed, but does not automatically provide legal, financial, architectural, engineering, or title-certification services.
Unless expressly agreed in writing, customers should obtain independent professional advice and verification.

title: 6. Role as a Real Estate Channel Partner

blocks.text: Dealinee Estate may act as a real estate intermediary, marketing associate, channel partner, or service coordinator between property owners, buyers, sellers, tenants, landlords, developers, and other authorised parties.
Our role may include sharing property information, arranging visits, generating enquiries, coordinating negotiations, and facilitating communication.
Unless specifically authorised through a written agreement:

items: Dealinee Estate does not act as the legal owner of a listed property.
We cannot independently transfer ownership or create rights over any property.
We cannot make binding commitments on behalf of property owners, developers, or other third parties.
Final transaction terms must be agreed upon by the relevant parties in their own written agreements.

blocks.text: Where applicable, our activities will be subject to the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 (RERA), applicable state regulations, and other relevant laws.
Dealinee Estate may coordinate property visits and site inspections based on availability and permission from the concerned property owner, landlord, developer, or authorised representative.
Users agree to:

items: Follow the property’s access and safety instructions.
Respect the property owner, residents, security personnel, and other visitors.
Avoid trespassing or entering restricted areas.
Not damage, remove, or misuse any property or its facilities.
Confirm the property’s availability before travelling for a visit.

blocks.text: Property visits are subject to confirmation and the relevant party’s permission.

For rental-related services:

items: The landlord and tenant are responsible for agreeing on rent, security deposit, rental duration, notice period, maintenance responsibilities, and other tenancy conditions.
The tenancy relationship will be governed by the applicable rental agreement and relevant laws.
Tenants should inspect the property and understand its condition before taking possession.
Landlords should provide accurate information about the property and their authority to rent it.
Dealinee Estate may assist with coordination but is not automatically a party to the landlord-tenant agreement.

blocks.text: Any property management or rent collection responsibilities undertaken by Dealinee Estate must be separately authorised and documented.
For property purchase and sale transactions:

items: Buyers and sellers are responsible for agreeing on the final sale price and transaction conditions.
The parties must independently verify the ownership, legal status, approvals, and other relevant details of the property.
Sale agreements, conveyance documents, registration, stamp duty, taxes, and other legal formalities must be completed as required by law.
Dealinee Estate may coordinate communication and documentation but does not replace the services of a qualified lawyer, financial adviser, or other professional.

blocks.text: The final transaction is subject to the written agreement between the buyer and seller and applicable law.
